name: Legare Farm Stand (N. Montpelier)
description: Legare Farm Stand (N. Montpelier) is a small farm in Montpelier, VT. It grows Strawberries, Blueberries, Raspberries, and Pumpkins, with seasonal availability through spring, summer, and autumn. The harvest is typically at its peak in summer. Check the website or call ahead for current hours and what is in season.
